book.name: EFEDZE
book.title: Mukaana a Poole Kundaa basi Efedze

content: Baana ya biburu
Baana, liikakihi litumu li biburu bi be, mu kuulu, obo oli bunsumu mu Mfumu.
Gwa taara ya ngughu a we budziri, munde me mukyene wu a nsomo wu li ya misiini:
mpaala we kala a esee ya we laama ŋa nsie .
Be bataara, ka likagwa baana ba be nkehe o, lo liikakwuhu bo kunsa maluo ya mu bigyehe bi Mfumu.
Bankana ya bamfumu
Bankana, liikasa bintamana kundaa bamfumu ba be baba ŋa nsie kunsa nzalamweẽ ya oteghere, mu mukolo wu bunya-nyaã, ti anga be ba lili mu okasa bintamana kundaa Kriste.
Ka likasa obo yini a ŋa mihi mi bo o, ti anga mu omoŋono bubwe kundaa baara, lo likakihi litumu ti anga bankana ba Kriste ba baakagyighili waa li Nzaami mu mukolo mumõ.
Liikasalala bo mu mukolo mumõ ti anga be lili mu okasalala Mfumu, lo ka ti anga ba bali mu okasalala baara o,
bu lisoolo ti, nswe mbwuru, ngu ali nkana bwunu we mbwuru wu bunya-nyaã, ndeme sa abagha mufuru kundaa Mfumu mu mandagha ma mabwe ma aakagyighili nde.
Kundaa be bamfumu, liikasa bwunu obo si kundaa bankana ba be. Linyaã miŋaana, bu lisoolo Mfumu a bo ya wu a ndaa be li mu mayulu, ya nde ka li a munsuolo a bidzili o.
Bidzwana bi ookagwa Nzaami
Mu omana, libagha mpini mu Mfumu, mu litumu li lileene li nde lwohono.
Lilaha bidzwana bi Nzaami byehene mpaala be lileene otemene ŋa nkulu a bigyighili bi dyabulu bibi emfiri-a-mpya.

Mu kuulu, ekyini ki lili a kye, ka eli kii odzwana mu musunu ya makili o, lo kii odzwana a bimpu, bamfumu ya lileene bi nsie yi a mpyibi yi a laŋa-laŋa yi, ekyini kii odzwana a lileene li mifulu mi mibi mi mili ku yulu, ŋa kara li mayulu ya nsie.
Mu obo, ligwolo bidzwana bi Nzaami byehene, mpaala be likala a mpini mu etsughu ki ebi ya bu limana ogyighili mandagha mwohono, be litemene bubwe.
Mu obo, ligyighili otemene! Lilaha engaŋma ti anga muswele mu bala, ya lilaha bunsumu ti anga enkuru kii mu bisyeẽ ki eekakyi butulu.
Lilaha ti anga bikoghoro mu myili mi be mana maa otsala Nsia yi Mbwe yi edzuunu.
Mu matala mwohono, ligwolo kana ti anga likubu, mu lo be lileene odzihibi magyo ma mbaa mama Wu Mubi.
Ligwolo si obvwughu ti anga mpu yi esyeẽ ya Ndagha a Nzaami ti anga lipee lili Mufulu.

Mu libaha li Mufulu, liikasamana mu Mufulu mu nswe matala mu nsa-nsamana yi mawa-mawa ya yi a opele. Mu obo likahala mihi ya mu nswe matala lisa mukama mu okapele Nzaami mu nkooro a baba ngili bwohono.
Liikasamana mu nkooro a mehe si, mpaala Nzaami agwa me ndagha yi olyele mu matala ma akala aandzubulu me muŋma mu otsala mu kana nsia a mansweghe ma Nsia yi Mbwe.
Mu nkooro a ndagha oyo me ndi embala kii Nsia yi Mbwe, wu bákuru misyi mimi bisyeẽ. Mu obo liikasamana mpaala me kambili ya kana mu Nsia yi Mbwe bwunu a bu mfaana me obili mu yo.
Mamboro mama masini
Tisyike sa agwa be mansia mwohono, mpaala behe si lisoolo mandagha ma matala me ya ma ndi mu okagyighili me. Nde li ndughu mu kana wu mukolo, musala a Mfumu wu bakughu osa kana mu nde.
Me ngweghe be nde mu mpere mpaala be lisoolo mandagha ma matala bihi, ya mpaala nde agwa be bukyini.
Nyaã edzuunu, dzyi ya kana bi bifi kundaa Nzaami Taara, ya kundaa Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste bikala ya bandughu mu kana!
Nyaã bwehe bukala ya babo bwohono ba baakadzyi Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste mu dzyi li liigwene okabyi!
